name: voxkey
description: VoxKey: Voice-Enabled Desktop Virtual Keyboard with real-time speech-to-text

scripts.bump:patch: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const parts = pkg.version.split('.').map(Number); parts[2]++; pkg.version = parts.join('.'); require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)); console.log('Bumped to ' + pkg.version);"
scripts.bump:minor: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const parts = pkg.version.split('.').map(Number); parts[1]++; parts[2]=0; pkg.version = parts.join('.'); require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)); console.log('Bumped to ' + pkg.version);"
